desc:
"Police Family Escape" is the game that is supposed to be the continuation of the "Police Prison Run Escape" game. 

Police Girl? Police Dad? Police Kid? All in one?! Escaping this jail sounds like a total madness - unless you're an experienced jail escaper!
Test your abilities and check if you can escape this full-security jail! Explore the secrets of the prison and the dark story behind it! 

If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the group wall. I frequently check the group wall.

Made by Timmy with ❤️.
